model.name: File/folder RENAME is the object's own behaviour — unit.rename(newName) overriding the derived name (displayName wins)
model.description: Tron directive 2026-09-06 (verbatim: 'we need a file/folder RENAME action'), framed by his standing law 'the solution MUST BE OOP DRY MVC'. RENAMING IS THE OBJECT'S OWN BEHAVIOUR: unit.rename(newName) — NOT a dialog with rename logic in it. The class already OWNS its name (Image names itself from capture time, Email from subject, Contact from full name, CalendarEntry from title+date, File from a clean basename); RENAME is the USER OVERRIDING the derived name ON the object. THREE distinct names: originalName (the raw input string we were wrongly displaying), derivedName (what the class computes for itself), displayName (what the user set — WINS when present). Nothing is lost; a rename never destroys the original. The user-override half of the naming design (R40.99 = the class owns its name; this = the user can override it).
model.tronQuote: > Tron 2026-09-06: 'we need a file/folder RENAME action' + standing law 'the solution MUST BE OOP DRY MVC'. Rename = the user overriding the derived name ON the object.

discoverySource.note: Ordered directly (no confirmation). User-override half of the naming design (R40.99 = class owns its name).

model.queuePriority: TIER-A behind the move (PO: planner queues it TIER-A behind the file/folder move work).
model.crossRefNote: Two halves of ONE naming design with R40.99 (the class OWNS its name; this = the USER can OVERRIDE it via displayName). Surfaced by the R33.9 action-context lifecycle (rename is a unit verb). Identity-stable rename = same law as the VCard->Contact rename (R40.99 AC-contact-reconcile-vcard-lens). Renders live via the one view bus (R37.20/R37.12 family).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Rename is the OBJECT'S OWN behaviour: unit.rename(newName) on the object, NOT a dialog/handler with rename logic in it. Callers ask the object; there is no free rename function/service.

gateRef.assertion: rename flows through unit.rename(newName); a dialog/handler/free-function containing rename logic => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed rename logic in a dialog/handler outside the object -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: THREE distinct names, never conflated: originalName (raw input string — NEVER displayed as the name), derivedName (class-computed), displayName (user-set, WINS when present). Display resolves displayName ?? derivedName; originalName is never the displayed name.

gateRef.assertion: displayed name = displayName if set else derivedName; originalName shown as the name => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed the raw originalName rendered as the object's name -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A FILE and a FOLDER can both be renamed from the room tree (the action is available on each).

gateRef.assertion: rename available + works on a file AND a folder from the room tree; unavailable on either => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed rename missing on a file or a folder in the tree -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The new name PERSISTS and RENDERS EVERYWHERE the object appears (tree, detail, preview) with NO reload — it is the OBJECT'S OWN VIEW updating (MVC, live via the one view bus).

gateRef.ref: test @390 rename renders all surfaces live
gateRef.assertion: after rename, tree+detail+preview show the new name with no reload; a surface not updating or needing a reload => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a surface that shows the stale name after rename (or needs a reload) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Rename does NOT change identity: the uuid is STABLE, links/children intact (same law as the VCard->Contact rename — a rename is a DISPLAY-name change, never an identifier change).

gateRef.assertion: after rename, uuid unchanged + all inbound/outbound refs + children resolve; a changed uuid or broken ref => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a rename that changes the uuid or breaks a ref/child link -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: An empty or whitespace-only new name is REJECTED (the rename does not apply; the object keeps its prior name).

gateRef.assertion: rename to '' or whitespace-only is rejected; an accepted empty/whitespace name => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed rename('') and rename('   ') -> both rejected, else RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The rename action is REGISTERED PER CLASS, so a 7th class gains rename with ZERO central-switch edits — both the open-set and closed-set lints stay 0 (no if/switch enumerating classes for rename).

gateRef.assertion: adding a class's rename requires no edit to a central switch; a switch/if-chain enumerating classes for rename => RED (open+closed lints == 0)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a central switch enumerating classes to decide rename -> RED
